title: fraxinus excelsior f. leucocarpa
intro: Fraxinus excelsior f. leucocarpa, commonly known as Ash tree, is a deciduous tree species that is native to Europe and western Asia. The health benefits of Fraxinus excelsior f. leucocarpa include its ability to act as a diuretic, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Fraxinus excelsior f. leucocarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
